paragraphs: R' Yishmael the Elder, son-in-law of R' Chanina.

Mentioned in [Berakhot 62b](https://www.sefaria.org/Berakhot.62b.12) according to Dikdukei Soferim's reading, reporting in the name of R' Chanina; the same reading appears in Yalkut on Samuel, remez 136.[^1][^2]

notes.text: Saba is lexically elder or grandfather, but this syntax naturally gives the epithet Elder followed by son-in-law of Chanina. The older grandfather-of-son-in-law proposal would more naturally require a linking d- and is not adopted. This is a grammatical reading, not a newly verified family identity.

The supplied Hebrew gives 22b. [Hyman’s printed notice, vol. III, p. 839](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/b/ba/Aaron_Hyman._Toldoth_Tannaim_veAmoraim._III._1910.pdf#page=6) gives 62b. The linked Bavli at that folio names Shmuel the Elder, Rabbi Chanina’s son-in-law, transmitting in Rabbi Chanina’s name. Hyman gives Yishmael from the readings he cites in Dikdukei Soferim and Yalkut Samuel. The comparison leaves the two names distinct.
